definition: eventTimes is precisely the range of eventTime n = 1/(n+1) in real time. The ambient interval [0,1] has first point 0; event occupancy is separate from the existence of a time. stageEvents is the range of stageTime n = 1 - eventTime n and omits time 1. Neither mathematical set claims physical occurrence.
